items.notes: GURPS equivalent: Compulsive Behavior (rituals). Intrusive thoughts and the rituals that answer them. -2 to anything done while a ritual is interrupted. [EP p. 214]

items.name: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
items.notes: GURPS equivalent: Flashbacks. Recurrent intrusion of a past event. Triggers cause a Will roll or a flashback; the Fall gave nearly everyone a candidate. [EP p. 214]
